hooks.name: useBeepSound
hooks.summary: Repeating beep for critical alerts
hooks.description: Play a repeating beep sound when `isAllowed` is true. Configurable volume, interval, and audio source — useful for overheating containers or equipment failures requiring audible notification.

hooks.name: useCheckPerm
hooks.summary: Check a single permission
hooks.description: Checks if the current user has a specific permission. Reads `permissions` from the headless `authStore` via the adapter. Simpler API than `useHasPerms` for one-shot checks.

hooks.name: useDeviceResolution
hooks.summary: Map window width to device class (mobile/tablet/desktop)
hooks.description: Classifies the current window width against the shared `BREAKPOINTS` constant so components can branch on device class without re-computing in every render.

hooks.name: useHasPerms
hooks.summary: Check one or more permissions
hooks.description: Returns a callable that accepts a permission request — string, string array (first match wins), or check object. Reads from the adapter `authStore`.

hooks.name: useIsFeatureEditingEnabled
hooks.summary: Whether feature-flag editing is allowed
hooks.description: Returns whether the current user has the `features` capability to edit feature flags.

hooks.name: useKeyDown
hooks.summary: Track whether a keyboard key is held down
hooks.description: Tracks whether a specific keyboard key is currently pressed. Attaches global `keydown`/`keyup` listeners. Useful for modifier-key UX (shift-click multi-select, etc.).

hooks.name: useLocalStorage
hooks.summary: Type-safe localStorage with cross-tab sync
hooks.description: Read and write JSON-serializable values in `localStorage` with cross-tab synchronization. Returns `[value, setValue, removeValue]`.

hooks.name: usePagination
hooks.summary: Pagination state with API limit/offset arguments
hooks.description: Manage pagination state and produce `{ limit, offset }` query args for API calls. Returns helpers for page/size changes and total updates.

hooks.name: usePduViewer
hooks.summary: Pan/zoom controller for the PDU floor-plan viewer
hooks.description: Pan/zoom controller wrapping `react-zoom-pan-pinch` with viewport-aware reset logic and a debounced "back to content" indicator when the user pans off-screen.

hooks.name: usePlatform
hooks.summary: Detect the host platform (iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux)
hooks.description: Returns the detected platform name from the user agent. Companion `detectPlatform` function and `OS_TYPES` constant are also exported.

hooks.name: useSubtractedTime
hooks.summary: Time minus a diff, refreshed on an interval
hooks.description: Returns `Date.now() - diff`, refreshing on a fixed interval (default 5s). Handy for "synced N seconds ago" labels without forcing a tree-wide re-render.

hooks.name: useTimezoneFormatter
hooks.summary: Read app timezone and format dates
hooks.description: Read the app timezone from the adapter `timezoneStore` and format dates for display. Use when foundation components or UI need timestamps in the operator-selected timezone (alerts, pool manager, dashboard widgets).

hooks.name: useWindowSize
hooks.summary: Track window width and height with resize listener
hooks.description: Returns `{ windowWidth, windowHeight }` and updates when the window resizes. Useful for responsive layouts that need pixel-level decisions.

hooks.name: useEbitda
hooks.summary: Transforms an `EbitdaResponse` and date-range options into query params and a chart-ready EBITDA view-model.
hooks.description: Transforms an `EbitdaResponse` and date-range options into query params and a chart-ready EBITDA view-model.

hooks.name: useEnergyBalanceViewModel
hooks.summary: Computes the full EnergyBalance view model from raw API data, managing tab selection and display-mode state.
hooks.description: Computes the full EnergyBalance view model from raw API data, managing tab selection and display-mode state.

hooks.name: usePoolConfigs
hooks.summary: Pure transform that maps caller-provided { data, isLoading, error } into PoolSummary objects for the Pool Manager UI.
hooks.description: Pure transform that maps caller-provided { data, isLoading, error } into PoolSummary objects for the Pool Manager UI.

hooks.name: useSiteOverviewDetailsData
hooks.summary: Composes the per-site overview view-model: pools, performance series, and recent activity.
hooks.description: Composes the per-site overview view-model: pools, performance series, and recent activity.

hooks.name: useReportTimeFrameSelectorState
hooks.summary: State hook backing the reporting time-frame selector — exposes the active window and setters.
hooks.description: State hook backing the reporting time-frame selector — exposes the active window and setters.

hooks.name: useTimeframeControls
hooks.summary: Core state machine for TimeframeControls — owns year / month / week selection and resolves the date-range output.
hooks.description: Core state machine for TimeframeControls — owns year / month / week selection and resolves the date-range output.

hooks.name: useFormField
hooks.summary: Read-only context hook for form field children — returns the field's id, error state, and ARIA attributes.
hooks.description: Read-only context hook for form field children — returns the field's id, error state, and ARIA attributes.

hooks.name: useFormReset
hooks.summary: Hook to handle form reset with callbacks.
hooks.description: Hook to handle form reset with callbacks.

hooks.name: useHashBalance
hooks.summary: Derives hash-balance metrics and chart datasets from finance log entries for the active date range, currency, and timefr
hooks.description: Derives hash-balance metrics and chart datasets from finance log entries for the active date range, currency, and timeframe type. Used by hash balance panels.

hooks.name: useSubsidyFees
hooks.summary: Aggregates raw subsidy-fee log entries into chart-ready datasets keyed by the active period type (day / week / month / y
hooks.description: Aggregates raw subsidy-fee log entries into chart-ready datasets keyed by the active period type (day / week / month / year) and surfaces a summary for the matching reporting widgets. Used by `Subsid…

hooks.name: useUpdateExistedActions
hooks.summary: Mutation hook that updates only the changed fields of an existing action record.
hooks.description: Mutation hook that updates only the changed fields of an existing action record.

hooks.name: useChartDataCheck
hooks.summary: Hook to check if chart data is empty or unavailable
hooks.description: Hook to check if chart data is empty or unavailable

hooks.name: useActions
hooks.summary: React-bound view of the headless `actionsStore`
hooks.description: React-bound view of the headless `actionsStore`. Pending submission queue, mark-as-done helpers, and other operator action state.

hooks.name: useAuth
hooks.summary: React-bound view of the headless `authStore`
hooks.description: React-bound view of the headless `authStore` from `@tetherto/mdk-ui-core`. Exposed as a hook for ergonomic call sites; equivalent to `useStore(authStore)`.

hooks.name: useDevices
hooks.summary: React-bound view of the headless `devicesStore`
hooks.description: React-bound view of the headless `devicesStore`. Selected-devices slice, set/clear actions, and other device state.

hooks.name: useNotifications
hooks.summary: React-bound view of the headless `notificationStore`
hooks.description: React-bound view of the headless `notificationStore`. Exposes the unread counter (`count`) and helpers to `increment`, `decrement`, and `reset` it. For the user-facing toast surface use `useNotification` from foundation.

hooks.name: useTimezone
hooks.summary: React-bound view of the headless `timezoneStore`
hooks.description: React-bound view of the headless `timezoneStore`. Read or update the operator timezone preference; use `useTimezoneFormatter` when you need formatting helpers.

hooks.name: useGetAvailableDevices
hooks.summary: Pure derivation that transforms a caller-provided Device[] into the available container and miner type sets for the device explorer.
hooks.description: Pure derivation that transforms a caller-provided Device[] into the available container and miner type sets for the device explorer.

hooks.name: useHeaderControls
hooks.summary: Read/write hook for the global header-controls store (toggles, sticky flag, theme).
hooks.description: Read/write hook for the global header-controls store (toggles, sticky flag, theme).

hooks.name: useNotification
hooks.summary: Custom hook for showing notifications backed by the headless `notificationStore`. Uses `@tetherto/mdk-react-devkit/core`
hooks.description: Custom hook for showing notifications backed by the headless `notificationStore`. Uses `@tetherto/mdk-react-devkit/core` Toast and Toaster components.

hooks.name: useSidebarExpandedState
hooks.summary: Custom hook to persist sidebar expanded state in localStorage
hooks.description: Custom hook to persist sidebar expanded state in localStorage

hooks.name: useSidebarSectionState
hooks.summary: Custom hook to persist individual section open/closed states in localStorage
hooks.description: Custom hook to persist individual section open/closed states in localStorage

hooks.name: useCostSummary
hooks.summary: Base hook for the cost-summary reporting page (single-site mode).
hooks.description: Base hook for the cost-summary reporting page (single-site mode).

hooks.name: useFinancialDateRange
hooks.summary: Resolves the active financial date range (start/end) used by every reporting-section query.
hooks.description: Resolves the active financial date range (start/end) used by every reporting-section query.

hooks.name: useSitesOverviewData
hooks.summary: Project site-overview container rows into PoolManagerSitesOverview-ready shape
hooks.description: Projects raw container rows and pool stats into a <PoolManagerSitesOverview />-ready shape with per-container hashrate, pool-stats attachment, and mining/offline status.

hooks.name: useSiteConsumption
hooks.summary: Latest site power consumption in MW from the tail-log
hooks.description: Projects the freshest power sample from the dashboard's tail-log query into a scalar MW value for the header stats strip. Delegates fetching to useSiteConsumptionChartData.

hooks.name: useSiteConsumptionChartData
hooks.summary: Site consumption tail-log samples as LineChartCard-ready payload
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook that fetches site consumption tail-log samples and returns a <LineChartCard>-ready ChartCardData payload.

hooks.name: useSiteContainerCapacity
hooks.summary: Aggregated nominal miner capacity across all site containers
hooks.description: Reads the aggregated nominal miner capacity across all site containers from the 5-minute tail-log aggregate — the denominator shown in the header.

hooks.name: useSiteEfficiency
hooks.summary: Site efficiency in W/TH/s derived from consumption and hashrate
hooks.description: Derives site efficiency in W/TH/s by dividing the latest site consumption by the latest hashrate. Pass powerW to use a power-meter reading as the numerator.

hooks.name: useSiteHashrate
hooks.summary: Latest aggregate site hashrate in PH/s and MH/s
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook that reads the latest aggregate hashrate from the site tail-log and returns both a PH/s display value and the raw MH/s backend value.

hooks.name: useSiteMinerCounts
hooks.summary: Online, offline, and error miner counts from the device list
hooks.description: Polls the device list for miners and aggregates them into online, offline, and error counts based on the last.status field.

hooks.name: useSiteMinerStats
hooks.summary: Live MOS total, online/offline breakdown, and pool worker count from stat-rtd
hooks.description: Polls the stat-rtd realtime aggregate for the live miner stat summary — MOS total, online/offline breakdown, and active pool worker count shown in the header.

hooks.name: useSitePowerMeter
hooks.summary: Current power-meter reading in MW from the t-powermeter device
hooks.description: Reads the current power-meter reading in watts from the site-level device tagged t-powermeter and returns both MW and raw W values.

hooks.name: usePoolRows
hooks.summary: Per-pool stats as PoolRow[] for the pool manager table
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook that fetches per-pool stats and transforms them into PoolRow[] objects shaped for the pool manager table, with hashrate normalised from H/s to PH/s.

hooks.name: usePoolStats
hooks.summary: Site-level pool totals: workers, hashrate, and mismatch count
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook that fetches per-pool stats and aggregates them into site-level totals — total workers, online workers, mismatch count, and aggregate hashrate in PH/s.

hooks.name: useDashboardDateRange
hooks.summary: Single source of truth for the dashboard date-range picker
hooks.description: Owns the dashboard's date-range picker state: a start/end ms-epoch pair with setters and a reset helper that restores the default 24-hour window.

hooks.name: useDashboardExport
hooks.summary: Export cached dashboard data as CSV or JSON file download
hooks.description: Reads cached query data for hashrate, consumption, incidents, and pool stats from TanStack Query and exposes exportCsv, exportJson, and a unified export(format) callable.

hooks.name: useDashboardTimeRange
hooks.summary: Scoped timeline selector state for the dashboard
hooks.description: Owns the current timeline string and canonical option list for the dashboard's timeline selector. Chart hooks consume timeline as a prop.

hooks.name: useConsumptionChartData
hooks.summary: Raw consumption tail-log samples from TanStack Query
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook returning raw consumption tail-log samples. Most dashboards should use useSiteConsumptionChartData, which wraps this and returns a LineChartCard-ready payload.

hooks.name: useHashrateChartData
hooks.summary: Site and per-pool hashrate time-series as LineChartCard-ready payload
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook combining the site tail-log hashrate series with per-pool hashrate history into a single ChartCardData payload for <LineChartCard />.

hooks.name: usePowerModeTimelineData
hooks.summary: Power-mode and status samples for PowerModeTimelineChart
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook returning power-mode and status samples shaped for <PowerModeTimelineChart data={...} />.

hooks.name: useAuthToken
hooks.summary: Read auth token from URL, persist to authStore, and strip from address bar
hooks.description: Reads ?authToken=… from window.location.search, persists it into the headless authStore, and strips the parameter via history.replaceState. Returns the current token so callers can gate navigation.

hooks.name: useTokenPolling
hooks.summary: Poll the token-refresh endpoint and handle session expiry
hooks.description: Polls the backend token-refresh endpoint at a fixed interval (default 250 s) and writes the new token back into the authStore. Fires onSessionEnded on 401 or 500.

hooks.name: useActiveIncidents
hooks.summary: Live list of currently-firing alerts for ActiveIncidentsCard
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook returning the list of currently-firing alerts shaped for <ActiveIncidentsCard items={...} />. Polls at 20 s by default to match Moria's production cadence.

hooks.name: useCurrentAlertDevices
hooks.summary: Raw alert-carrying devices for the `CurrentAlerts` / `Alerts` table
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook returning devices that currently carry one or more alerts as the nested `ListThingsDevice[][]` the devkit `<Alerts>` / `<CurrentAlerts>` table expects. Accepts `filterTags` to narrow the server-side `list-things` query and `refetchInterval` (default 20 s).

hooks.name: useHistoricalAlerts
hooks.summary: Historical alert log over a date range for the `HistoricalAlerts` table
hooks.description: TanStack Query hook that fetches the `history-log` endpoint over a `[start, end]` range, merges results by `uuid`, and shapes rows via `mapHistoryLogToAlerts` for the devkit `<HistoricalAlerts>` table. Range changes abort in-flight requests through the query's `AbortSignal`.

hooks.name: useOperationsDashboard
hooks.summary: Shapes raw operational metric logs into chart-ready payloads for OperationalDashboard
hooks.description: Shapes raw operational metric logs into LineChartCardData and stacked-bar payloads for the four OperationalDashboard cards (hashrate, power consumption, site efficiency, miners status). Handles all unit conversion — no fetching.

hooks.name: useHashrate
hooks.summary: Normalise a grouped-hashrate query result for hashrate tab views
hooks.description: Base hook for a single hashrate tab in single-site mode. Normalises a grouped-hashrate query result to the { log, isLoading, error } shape consumed by HashrateSiteView, HashrateMinerTypeView, and HashrateMiningUnitView.

hooks.name: useEnergyReportSite
hooks.summary: Merge consumption, tail-log, and container data for the Energy report site tab
hooks.description: Merges site energy consumption (v2 /auth/metrics/consumption) with snapshot tail-log and container list data for the Energy report site tab, returning the combined view-model.
